title: Healthy Families and Workplaces Act (Colorado Revised Statutes, Title 8, Article 13.3, Part 4)
verified_how: Expanded the official CRS Annotated table of contents: 'Title 8' > 'Labor Conditions (Arts. 11 - 14.4)' > 'Article 13.3. Family and Medical Leave (Pts. 1 - 5)', whose parts are shown as 'Part 1. Parental Involvement', 'Part 2. Family and Medical Leave Eligibility (ss 8-13.3-201 - 8-13.3-205)', 'Part 3. Family and Medical Leave Implementation', 'Part 4. Healthy Families and Workplaces (ss 8-13.3-401 - 8-13.3-418)' and 'Part 5. Paid Family and Medical Leave Insurance (ss 8-13.3-501 - 8-13.3-524)'.
notes: Part 4 is the paid sick leave mandate (HFWA). Part 5 is the separate FAMLI paid family and medical leave insurance programme, benefits payable since 2024; only one statute per topic is listed, but both parts of Article 13.3 matter for leave.
